judgment.baseline: B(t) = median of 7-day means ending t-365 .. t-1 (complete blocks only); not recomputed
judgment.comparison: mean > m * B(t) and mean > V (both strict)
judgment.current_level: latest complete 7-day mean ending t-1 .. t-7 (reads t-13 .. t-1); none -> null
judgment.min_level_rule: V = the tag inclusion threshold A (mean daily ratio over the method block), determined only from method-block data and sealed together with the tag list, before the models (owner decision 2026-10-06, CLAUDE.md)
judgment.missing_block: a 7-day block with any missing day is not used
judgment.missing_day: fewer than 72 of 96 15-minute files acquired, or total volume 0
judgment.statistic: max over 7-day means fully inside the window
judgment.target: B(t) and current level both defined and current level <= B(t); otherwise not a target that week
judgment.zero_baseline: tag with B(t) = 0 stays a prediction target

rate_table_checks: same target count for every multiplier within a horizon
hit count non-increasing in multiplier within a horizon
sealed_before_models: missing-day list of the method block
sealed_before_threshold_access: tag list, V, missing-day list of the method block
target rule (this file: is_target, current_level, baseline_level)
rule for tags that already jumped (scoring plan); without it, do not proceed
naive-model lookback (counted including 7-day blocks) as a periods trigger
selection_rule: low tier: multiplier with rate in [low, high], closest to center on log scale; tie -> larger multiplier
high tier: multiplier smaller than the low-tier one, rate in range, closest to center; tie -> larger multiplier
first horizon where both tiers are found
none found -> stop and report to owner; owner sees only the rate table
threshold_period_order: seal missing-day list for the threshold block (before any label)
compute labels and the rate table for all 21 combinations
seal the rate table and the select() result
model / stick-chart / naive outputs are not computed on the threshold period
